command.name: security key-manager prepare-to-downgrade
command.description: This command is deprecated and might be removed in a future release. The security key-manager prepare-to-downgrade command disables the Onboard Key Manager features that are not supported in releases prior to ONTAP 9.1.0. The features that are disabled are Onboard Key Manager support for MetroCluster configurations and Volume Encryption (VE).
command.example:
The following example disables the Onboard Key Manager support for MetroCluster configurations and Volume Encryption (VE):
cluster1::*> security key-manager prepare-to-downgrade
